issue_title: [Perf] _sanitize_text 对超长文本可能存在性能问题

triage_summary.root_cause: The _sanitize_text function in src/flywheel/formatter.py uses O(n) character-by-character iteration with Python-level loop (lines 31-38). While algorithmically correct, the Python-level for-loop with append creates significant overhead for large texts due to interpreter overhead per iteration.
risk_points: src/flywheel/formatter.py:31-38 - Python-level char iteration is slow for large inputs
src/flywheel/cli.py:100,110,115 - Direct _sanitize_text calls on user input without length limits
No maximum text length validation in add command path

proposed_verification.approach: Use str.translate() with pre-computed translation table - O(n) but with C-level implementation
proposed_verification.test_strategy: Create performance benchmark test comparing current vs optimized implementation

constraints: Must preserve exact same output behavior (security-sensitive function)
Must pass all existing sanitization tests (backslash escape, control chars, C1 chars)
TDD: Write failing benchmark first, then optimize

plan.description: Optimize _sanitize_text for large text using str.translate()

implementation_sequence.details: Add benchmark test that verifies 1MB text processing < 100ms. Current implementation will fail this.

Replace character-by-character loop with str.translate() using pre-computed translation table for control characters (0x00-0x1f, 0x7f-0x9f). Keep backslash/newline/tab replacements as str.replace() calls.

implementation_sequence.action: Verify all existing tests still pass
implementation_sequence.details: Run existing sanitization tests to ensure behavior is preserved
